RUNEPRIEST-INSCRIBE.title: Inscribe
RUNEPRIEST-INSCRIBE.description: Add a rune to the end of your Incantation. If it matches the rune before it, they merge and their values add up. At the end of your turn it is [gold]Spoken[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-SPEAK.title: Speak
RUNEPRIEST-SPEAK.description: Resolve your Incantation from left to right, then clear it. Runes that make no sense fizzle harmlessly.
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUE.title: Imbue
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUE.description: Remove the X most recently inscribed runes from your Incantation and bind them to this card for the rest of combat, filling its Imbue slot. Once Imbued, playing the card [gold]Inscribes[/gold] its runes instead, aimed at the enemy you target. An Imbued card can't be Imbued again.
RUNEPRIEST-IMBUED.title: Imbued
RUNEPRIEST-INCANTATION_SCRIPT.title: Current Incantation
RUNEPRIEST-OVERFLOW.title: Overflow
RUNEPRIEST-OVERFLOW.description: When your Incantation is full, the oldest rune is [gold]Spoken[/gold] on its own immediately.
RUNEPRIEST-FIZZLE.title: Fizzle
RUNEPRIEST-FIZZLE.description: The rune sputters out without doing anything. Runes fizzle when they make no sense: a malformed rune, a voided rune, a targeting rune that is never used, or an empowering rune with nothing after it.
RUNEPRIEST-ETCH.title: Etch
RUNEPRIEST-ETCH.description: At a rest site with the [gold]Eternal Candle[/gold], remove a rune card from your deck and bind its runes to your [gold]Eternal Scroll[/gold] for the rest of the run. Each [gold]Etching[/gold] makes the Scroll cost 1 more.
RUNEPRIEST-FORECAST.title: Forecast
RUNEPRIEST-FORECAST.note: [color=#a0a0a0]Includes Strength, Weak, Vulnerable, Frail, etc. Effects on random or multiple targets (like their Vulnerable) aren't included.[/color]
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_STRIKE.title: Strike
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DEFEND.title: Defend
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DEFEND.description: Gain {Value} [gold]Block[/gold]. Only affects you, never other players.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND.title: Mend
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND.description: Heal {Value} HP. Only affects you, never other players.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_HEX.title: Hex
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DIMINISH.title: Diminish
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DIMINISH.description: Attack the target for {Value} damage. Its value halves every time it resolves, and it [gold]Persists[/gold]; below 5 it [gold]Fizzles[/gold] away instead.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CLEANSE.title: Cleanse
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CLEANSE.description: Remove all debuffs from you and every [blue]Blood[/blue] rune from your Incantation. Has no value and cannot be amplified.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_BLOOD.title: Blood
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_KINDLE.title: Kindle
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_KINDLE.description: Gain {Value} [gold]Energy[/gold] next turn, or now if Spoken mid-turn. Cannot be amplified.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SWIFT.title: Swift
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SWIFT.description: Draw {Value} cards next turn, or now if Spoken mid-turn. Cannot be amplified.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SANCTIFY.title: Sanctify
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SANCTIFY.description: [blue]Blood[/blue] in the next rune has no effect. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], protects the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_AMPLIFY.title: Amplify
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_AMPLIFY.description: The next rune's values gain {Value}. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], empowers the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_TWIN.title: Twin
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_TWIN.description: Multiply the next rune's values by {Value}. Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], empowers the whole loop.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ECHO.title: Echo
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ECHO.description: Resolve the next rune {Value} extra time(s). Before a [blue]Loop[/blue], multiplies its repetitions.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_VOID.title: Void
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_VOID.description: Consumes the next rune, even another [blue]Void[/blue] or a [blue]Loop[/blue]: it [gold]Fizzles[/gold] and is gone for the rest of the [gold]Speak[/gold]. The Void remains, consuming again each time it is [gold]Spoken[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_GROWTH.title: Growth
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_GROWTH.description: The next rune waits instead of resolving. Each time Growth is [gold]Spoken[/gold] (a [blue]Loop[/blue] speaks it every pass), it ticks down and doubles that rune's values. After {Value} tick(s) Growth vanishes, and the rune resolves the next time it is [gold]Spoken[/gold]. Runes inscribed onto a growing rune never merge into it.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_OVERGROWTH.title: Overgrowth
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_OVERGROWTH.description: Each time Overgrowth is [gold]Spoken[/gold] (a [blue]Loop[/blue] speaks it every pass), it ticks down and doubles the next rune's values. That rune still resolves, and stays for next turn. After {Value} tick(s) Overgrowth vanishes, and the rune resolves once more the next time it is [gold]Spoken[/gold]. Runes inscribed onto a growing rune never merge into it.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_OVERGROWTH_ASCENDED.desc: Each time Overgrowth is [gold]Spoken[/gold] (a [blue]Loop[/blue] speaks it every pass), it ticks down and doubles the next rune's values. That rune [gold]still resolves[/gold], and stays for next turn. After {Value} tick(s) Overgrowth vanishes, and the rune resolves once more the next time it is [gold]Spoken[/gold]. Runes inscribed onto a growing rune never merge into it.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_REFLECTION.title: Reflection
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_REFLECTION.description: When [gold]Spoken[/gold], the Incantation turns around: earlier runes are Spoken again in reverse order, as they stand now. Runes after the Reflection are never Spoken, and a [blue]Loop[/blue] still open stops repeating.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CLONE.title: Clone
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_CLONE.description: [gold]Persists[/gold]. Each time it is Spoken, a copy of the next rune is kept for next turn. The copy [gold]Persists[/gold] too.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_FRIENDSHIP.title: Friendship
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_FRIENDSHIP.description: The next supportive rune affects ALL players instead of only you.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_FRIENDSHIP_ALL.title: Friendship
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_FRIENDSHIP_ALL.descripti: ALL later supportive runes affect every player instead of only you.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ANCHOR.title: Anchor
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_ANCHOR.description: Later runes hit the enemy chosen when their card was played. This is the default.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SCATTER.title: Scatter
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SCATTER.description: Later runes hit a random enemy each time.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_NOVA.title: Nova
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_NOVA.description: Later runes hit ALL enemies. Supportive runes still only affect you.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_EXECUTION.title: Execution
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_EXECUTION.description: Later runes hit the enemy with the lowest HP.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MIRROR.title: Mirror
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MIRROR.description: Later offensive runes hit YOU, and supportive runes aid an enemy. Any other targeting rune ends the Mirror.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_LOOP.title: Loop
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_LOOP.description: Speak the runes up to the next [blue]End Loop[/blue] twice. An unclosed Loop runs to the end. Nest Loops to repeat more.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_END_LOOP.title: End Loop
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEAL.title: Seal
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_SEAL.description: Stop Speaking. Runes after the Seal wait until next turn.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_STRIKE_ASCENDED.title: Ascended Strike
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_STRIKE_ASCENDED.descript: Attack the target for {Value} damage with [gold]divine radiance[/gold].
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DEFEND_ASCENDED.title: Ascended Defend
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DEFEND_ASCENDED.descript: Gain {Value} [gold]Block[/gold] infused with sacred power. Only affects you, never other players.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND_ASCENDED.title: Ascended Mend
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_MEND_ASCENDED.descriptio: Heal {Value} HP with restorative light. Only affects you, never other players.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_HEX_ASCENDED.title: Ascended Hex
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_HEX_ASCENDED.description: Apply {Value} [gold]Weak[/gold] and {Value} [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] to the target with curse and divine wrath.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DIMINISH_ASCENDED.title: Ascended Diminish
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_DIMINISH_ASCENDED.descri: Attack the target for {Value} damage with fading light. Its value halves every time it resolves, and it [gold]Persists[/gold]; below 5 it [gold]Fizzles[/gold] away instead.
RUNEPRIEST-RUNE_BLOOD_ASCENDED.title: Ascended Blood
